packageRules.description: Every non-major update, all managers, lands in one PR that merges itself once required checks pass. Nothing here should need a human on a normal month. NOTE: this now automerges github-actions and pip_requirements, which used to be manual -- scripts/ still has no PR-level CI, so a bad Python bump surfaces only when the monthly contributions workflow runs.
Majors stay separate and manual -- this is where breakage lives, and isolating them means one bad major cannot hold back everything else.

Astro core and integrations must move in lockstep on a major (astro v7 requires @astrojs/mdx v7). Widens the built-in monorepo group to any @astrojs/* package, including ones published outside withastro/astro.
React runtime and its DefinitelyTyped types live in separate repos, so the built-in monorepo group misses @types/react. Keep them in one major PR.
